# A radio group's `disabled` is written to the box the build made of it,
# and to no other: its `if direction == ui.Orientation.horizontal`, spliced
# with the default and folded away (on C, as `0 == 1` once NoEnum made the
# members ints), gets no updater, where it wrote the horizontal box it never
# built and GTK reported a critical, which fails a C test. The radio's
# `disabled == false` reads sngl:builtin's `false`, a const the flip's
# closure reads where it is rather than capturing.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c radio.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- radio.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var size = 1
    var off = true
    ui.vbox {
        ui.radio #sizes(:value=size, disabled=off) {
            ui.choice(label="small", value=1)
            ui.choice(label="large", value=2)
        }
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click {
            off = !off
        })
    }
}

ui.window(title="Radio") {
    main()
}

func testEnables(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(!c.off)
    c.sizes.change(2)
    t.assert(c.size == 2)
}
-- testrun/gtk4/c/radio.sngl/main/1 --

      "Desc": "Enables",
      "Passed": true
    }

}
